message:
Accented letters now survive in blog slugs: "Crème brûlée recipes" becomes `creme-brulee-recipes`. `npm test` passes all 3 tests, including `test/blog-slug.test.js`.

The cause was in `vendor/slugify`, which deletes every character outside `a-z0-9`, so `è` and `û` were removed before any accent handling could help. I didn't touch `vendor/` (the project notes say it's the platform team's). Instead, the fix is in `src/blog/slug.js`: the title is decomposed to NFD form, so each accent becomes a separate combining mark, and those marks are stripped before the vendored `slugify` runs. The change is one line plus a comment. Nothing is committed.

Side effect to be aware of: `postSlug` now also strips accents from any title it receives, which is the intended behavior for blog URLs. The product URL slug in `src/shop/product-url.js` is unaffected.
